notes: Lending to 'properties for social, cultural and educational purposes' is ordinary lending and was not counted for Creativity. 'We support local initiatives through partnerships and sponsorships' is general language with no specifics. The biodiversity area's aim to offer learning and education is aspirational, so it was not counted. The double materiality assessment rates S3 Affected communities as not material. The 'marketplace in the online bank' is not described as a seller marketplace, so it was not counted. 'More than 700 colleagues have completed the course' was not used because the excerpt does not identify the course. The E3 quote spans a hyphenated line break ('com-mitment') in the source PDF. Fossil fuel and coal exclusions and a small tobacco retail exposure in the taxonomy table are lending and investment screens, not red flags. The report states no serious human rights issues or incidents were reported.
